claim: PATCH /procurement/orders/:id is not a side door around the sealed acts, neither it nor createOrder's dedup merge moves an open order's money for staff, a price change is filed best-effort, and the two uncalled alert relays are closed (ADR 0244 D1, D2, D4; founder rulings 2026-09-29; 817-route audit at 5a20d774b, re-verified at c47fd8a01). (1) procurement.service.ts updateOrder refuses ANY dto.status with 422 reason status_through_its_act unless the caller already ran the transition (opts.statusTransitionAlreadyChecked, set only by cancelOrder), naming the act that makes the move (whereThisMoveIsMade); before, any member moved PENDING/APPROVAL_NEEDED/NEGOTIATING to APPROVED with no seal, no approval rule, no approved_by and no reservation, and reached REJECTED, FAILED, DELIVERED, CONFIRMED, COMPLETED the same way. The cancel refusal (cancel_through_the_sealed_act) is kept. (2) ORDER_MONEY_FIELDS (quotedPrice, negotiatedPrice, finalPrice, totalCost, priceVerified) require OrganizationsService.assertCanManageRestaurant(actor, house, change an order's price); an unwired helper is a 500 and an unnamed actor a 403, both before any write; the figures are read first (readOrderMoneyBefore, a failed read refuses) and every moved column is filed as order_price_changed in system_audit_log with from, to and the door (best-effort: recordOrderPriceChanged never throws and logs a failed write). The second door, createOrder's dedup merge (POST /procurement/orders folding into the open order for the same house, wine and vendor), moved quantity, unit, bottles and every price of an APPROVAL_NEEDED/NEGOTIATING/APPROVED order for any member (ADR 0090 security review of #538 at e5edf9af1); a fold that moves any of MERGE_MONEY_COLUMNS on an order past PENDING now needs the same helper (403 merge_would_change_price, actor threaded from the controller) and files order_price_changed with door merge; a PENDING fold keeps the re-quote for any member and is filed. The fold's header UPDATE is conditional on the house, id, status, updated_at and every MERGE_MONEY_COLUMNS value the lookup read (eq / is null) and uses maybeSingle; zero rows is a 409 merge_target_changed with no line write and no audit row (the audit planner's stale-status race at d033412f5). The merge files order_price_changed right after the header write, before upsertOrderLine. ROUND 3 (v3 audit at e9c6ffe89; the founder waived ADR 0231's two-round cap once and picked Third round: gate the line, 2026-09-30): the fold reads the held line(s) (readHeldOrderLines; a failed read refuses), computes the line it would write with lineMoneyFor (the one builder upsertOrderLine also writes with) and compares LINE_MONEY_COLUMNS (quantity, unit_type, bottles_per_unit, quoted/negotiated/final unit price, price_uom, price_pack_size, currency, allowance, deposit, freight, line_total, vendor_sku); more than one held line is a change; a line change feeds the same gate and the same row as line.<column>; the line is rewritten only when it moves; a re-post that changes nothing writes nothing; the quoted and negotiated unit prices, the currency and the SKU are carried forward on omission and the unit pair and fees are not. The controller passes { actorUserId: user.userId } and never the cancel-only opts. No client sends this PATCH (git grep apps/web/src, apps/mobile, packages, services, scripts, apps/web/e2e, 2026-09-29): ordersApi.updateOrder/updateOrderStatus are uncalled, the legacy Mark as Ordered went with #494; this verify fails if a web or mobile file starts calling updateOrderStatus, or calls updateOrder / ordersApi.updateOrder with a status (the helper's own one-line body excepted). (3) POST /communications/alerts/low-stock and /alerts/daily-summary are gone with resolveAlertTenant and DailySummaryDto (ADR 0149 answer 15 posture); no caller in apps, packages, services; ScheduledTasksService still sends both through CommunicationsService with house-register recipients and the tenant's own websocket room. D3 (re-check the limit on approved orders, ruled 2026-09-30) is NOT this claim: it is built on #541 (fix/order-price-recheck, stacked on this branch) and held out of this PR, so on this branch a manager can still reprice an approved order within the role gate. Behaviour: order-patch-is-not-a-side-door.spec.ts (57 cases over HTTP, 27 red on c47fd8a01, 2 more red without the audit row, 7 merge cases red at e5edf9af1, 3 race/ordering cases red at d033412f5, 13 red at e9c6ffe89 for the line gate), alert-relays-are-closed.spec.ts (5 cases, 4 red on c47fd8a01); 30 of 30 service/controller mutations killed (7 on the merge gate, 4 on the conditional write and the paper's order, 10 on the line gate). This verify: 28 reasons on c47fd8a01, 13 at e5edf9af1, 10 at d033412f5, 9 at e9c6ffe89, and 29 of 29 tripwire mutations (cancel refusal, cancel-only opts, scheduled producers, a client relay call, an updateOrderStatus call, a dropped money field, an empty scan, the pre-read, the paper, the ADR, the merge gate, a dropped merge quantity, the merge paper, updateOrder with a status in web one-line, web multi-line, mobile shorthand, the helper's body edited, the merge write's status filter, the 409 reason, the paper moved after the line, vendor_sku dropped from the line columns, no held-line read, a line move kept off the gate, the line always rewritten, a no-op that writes, two builders, a carried fee, a wiped SKU, and updated_at dropped) each reported, and a notes-only updateOrder call left alone, 2026-09-30.
